json.title: Endless Coastal Summer
json.logline: A glowing gouache memory of driving along the sunlit coast where time stood still.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: A gentle piano note hits as a girl gazes out a car window at sunset
Gouache brushstrokes bloom softly around her face
String swells begin as the coastal horizon expands
Golden flash opens into a sweeping ocean vista
Collage of sea spray and wind-blown hair fragments
Final warm chord decays over a peaceful dusk horizon

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push toward her profile framed by the car window.
scenes.action: A young woman in a yellow linen dress gazes dreamily through a car window at sunset.
scenes.setting: Interior of a vintage car driving down a coastal road illuminated by dusk.

scenes.camera_note: Layered parallax effect separating subject from soft painterly hills.
scenes.action: The young woman turns her head slightly toward the open ocean breeze.
scenes.setting: Coastal highway edge with distant sage green hills and glowing pink sky.

scenes.camera_note: Tilting up smoothly from her sunlit hand on the car door to her glowing face.
scenes.action: Her medium-length dark brown hair flows freely in the warm coastal wind.
scenes.setting: Open convertible cruising past sun-bleached terracotta cliffside rocks.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid push in on her expression as the cliffside crests.
scenes.action: The young woman smiles softly into the intense golden light.
scenes.setting: Top of a coastal ridge bathed in bright golden-hour halation.

scenes.camera_note: Wide soaring pull-out revealing the expansive shimmering ocean below.
scenes.action: The young woman stands atop a seaside cliff overlook with arms slightly outstretched.
scenes.setting: Panoramic cliffside overlook above a boundless ocean bathed in golden-amber light.

scenes.camera_note: Multi-plane drift showing overlapping memories in visible gouache strokes.
scenes.action: The young woman reaches out her hand catching glowing ocean spray.
scenes.setting: Layered gouache memory fragments of crashing waves and sunlit shoreline.

scenes.camera_note: Slow calming dolly out as the sky softens into deep purple.
scenes.action: The young woman rests quietly against the car bonnet watching twilight settle.
scenes.setting: Quiet coastal viewpoint under a calm blue-violet sunset sky.
